newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK & Co plans 1-for-5 bonus warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: SHK & Co plans 1-for-5 bonus warrant issue.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd said on Monday it proposes to make a one-for-five bonus issue of warrants carrying the right to subscribe for new shares at an initial subscription price of HK$2.50 per share.
The warrant would be exercisable at any time from the issue date to February 18, 2000, on a one warrant for one new share basis, the company said in a statement.
The financial services and brokerage firm said it would issue no more than 194.28 million warrants on the basis of 971.39 million shares of the company in issue.
Shares of the company closed Friday at HK$2.40 each.
Sun Hung Kai said the issue would strengthen its financial position and it would seek shareholders approval on the issue at an extraordinary general meeting to be convened later.
The warrants would be traded in board lots of 10,000 units, it added.
